verdict.rationale: Kushki's own docs clearly cover accepting online card payments, through the card-payment API, the kushki.js library, the Kajita checkout form, Smartlink payment links and e-commerce plugins. There is also a test-data and move-to-production guide, and an aggregator integration model is mentioned. Nothing in the evidence shows self-serve signup, onboarding or KYC turnaround, or how long it takes to go live, which is the defining 'within a day' part of the story. missing for 10: evidence of self-serve signup and same-day activation, documented time-to-production or onboarding/approval timelines, hands-on or independent reports of fast go-live.
